consent.label: Text of the declaration — what the person agrees to
consent.placeholder: e.g. As a parent or legal guardian I consent to my child taking part…
consent.hint: Shown in full below the tick box; “Question” is a short name (e.g. “Consent to take part”).
consent.edited: A change affects only new answers — each consent given keeps the text it was given to.
consent.fresh: A ticked consent is saved together with this text — a later change does not replace it.

field.noEpochKey: You do not have the key of this epoch.
field.noFormKey: You do not have the key of the form's area — the question cannot be sealed.
field.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Which parish are you from?
field.kindFixed: Follows from what the question is about.
field.areaHintForm: The answers go to the chosen area — only those with access to it can read them. The question itself lies in the form's questions area.
field.areaHint: The question will be sealed with this area's key — publicly readable only if the area is public.
field.kindChange: You can change the kind only while nobody has answered.
field.optionsByNeed: Options — set by the requirement “{need}” (change them in its settings)
field.moving: The collected answers will move to the new area.

who.bothSays: The person will see “Correct details” in their portal; the office can correct it too.
who.officeSays: The person will see the answer, but only the office can change it.
who.personSays: Only the person themselves enters and corrects it (through their link). The office can read it but will neither change it nor enter it for them.

logic.help: Add a node from the palette, connect an output (right dot) to an input (left dot), click a node to set it up. The Delete key removes the selected node or edge.
logic.clash: The logic can hide questions marked as required: {list}. The service checks “required” without the logic — whoever does not see them cannot send the form. Untick “Required” on the question and add a “Required” node here with the same condition as “Show”.
logic.readsNothing: The logic does not read any answer yet — add an “Answer” node.
logic.locked: Belongs to the requirement “{need}” — it can be moved, but changed or deleted only after turning the requirement off (tab “Questions”).
logic.ageFrom: Age from the question (date of birth or PESEL)
logic.ageHint: E.g. the day of departure. The result is full years — connect it to “Comparison” (A < 18) to show the fields for minors. Without a date (or with a wrong PESEL) the result is empty and the comparison is not met.
logic.valueHint: Numbers are compared as numbers, the rest as text (ignoring case).
logic.compare: How to compare A with B

op.and: True when all inputs are true.
op.or: True when at least one input is true.
op.xor: True when an odd number of inputs is true (with two: exactly one).
op.not: Inverts: true becomes false and vice versa.

logic.falsy: The answer “no”, “0” or an empty field counts as false.
logic.showWhat: What to show when the input is true
logic.showHint: Several “Show” on one target — all must be met.
logic.labelLabel: Field name when the input is true

family.hasEntries: “{name}” already has entries ({count}) — they belong to people, so the sub-form cannot be deleted. You can close it in the “Settings” tab: there will be no new entries.
family.removeAsk: Delete the sub-form “{name}”? Its questions, layout and logic will disappear, and people will no longer see the step “Fill in”. This cannot be undone.

onPages.one: It stands on the page {pages} — it will be taken off it.
onPages.other: It stands on the pages {pages} — it will be taken off them.

family.namePlaceholder: e.g. Tasks for the coming weeks
family.name: Sub-form name
family.fillsPerson: filled in by the person (through their link)
family.addHint: A sub-form is added to the entries of “{name}” — the person fills it in through their link (or only the coordinator).
family.groupLabel: Form group (folder — nothing changes for those filling in)
family.groupHint: You create a group on the list of forms (“+ New group”).
family.audiencePerson: the person — through their link (in their steps “Fill in”)
family.audienceLocked: There are entries already — who fills it in can be changed only in an empty sub-form.

layout.hint: A group gathers questions under one heading. Successive pages are filled in one after another — the next opens when all required answers on the previous one are given. Successive tabs are available at once. Groups can be nested.
layout.printTitle: Whether the answer goes onto the printout for signing
layout.sign: to sign on the printout (consent, declaration — without a tick box)

map.lExtends: sub-form (filled in through the person's link)
map.lLogic: depends on the form (page logic map)
map.empty: There are no forms here yet.
map.hint: Click a form or a page to open it. You change groups on the list of forms.

fmap.personNamed: person: {who} — their signature in conversations and on lists
fmap.personNameless: no First name and Surname fields — the person will have no name (conversations, lists)
fmap.fillsPerson: filled in by the person — through their link

qarea.label: Questions are visible in the area
qarea.public: “{name}” — public: anyone who opens the page will read the questions.
qarea.private: “{name}” — not public: only those who read this area will read the questions.
qarea.answersTo: The answers go to the form's area “{name}”.
qarea.why: The answers always stay in the form's area. Only whoever runs both areas can move the questions to another area.
qarea.noKey: Not every question can be read now — the key of the area it lies under is missing.
qarea.noOwn: The form has no area of its own yet.
qarea.noTarget: You do not have the key of the area where the questions should be visible.
